title: The witch's scrying eye
prompt:

Create exactly ONE isolated game prop/creature, with true transparent background. No model sheet, labels, extra examples or stage backdrop. Canvas aspect ratio 200:300, intended delivery 200 x 300 pixels. Preserve the entire silhouette. Asset scrying-eye.
